Politics · India

Opposition Protests Parliament Absence, Temple Fund Allegations

Opposition MPs protested in the Parliament complex, demanding Home Minister Amit Shah's presence and raising slogans against him. They also linked his absence to the alleged theft of Ram temple donations and a recent police action against students. Separately, Arvind Kejriwal's protest march against the E20 fuel policy was stopped by police. The BJP accused the opposition of stalling Parliament and blocking debate on key bills.
